description: This PHP script handles AJAX calls for a SuiteCRM extension. It checks user permissions, retrieves a method name from request parameters, and invokes the corresponding method on the PackageController class if it exists, otherwise outputs 'no method'.

classes.name: PackageController
classes.description: A class handling package-related operations within the SuiteCRM application.

methods.name: <unknown>
methods.description: The method invoked dynamically based on the 'method' request parameter, from the PackageController class.
